name: Israel Science Foundation
scope_note: This is the personal-grant budget taxonomy, not a global ISF taxonomy. Financial reporting follows the grant's approved budget lines. Confirm the program, award year, approved budget, and any written exceptions before deciding eligibility.
scope_note_he: הסיווגים מבוססים על הנחיות המענק האישי לשנת 2025/26. אין רשימת קטגוריות אחידה שאומתה לכל מסלולי הקרן. בדוח כספי קובעות שורות התקציב המאושר; לפני בדיקת זכאות יש לאמת מסלול, שנת מענק, תקציב ואישורים בכתב.

categories.examples: Research staff, graduate students, and postdoctoral researchers charged to the grant.
categories.review_when: Employment role, grant allocation, or investigator/faculty eligibility is unclear.

categories.examples: Research consumables and minor tools used in the project.
categories.review_when: The item could instead be dedicated equipment, computing, a service, or general infrastructure.

categories.examples: Consulting, samples or data, participant payments, maintenance, and a one-time research repository deposit.
categories.review_when: The invoice does not show the research service or its project connection.

categories.examples: Essential project-specific expenses that do not fit another heading, including narrowly permitted scientific travel for grant-funded graduate students or postdocs.
categories.review_when: The item may be routine travel, hospitality, or another excluded cost; do not use this as a catch-all.

categories.examples: Software, computers, cloud services, peripherals, and dedicated computing.
categories.review_when: The charge is a general infrastructure purchase or the computer user and purpose are unclear.

categories.examples: Professional literature, journal publication and needed editing or translation, photocopies, office supplies, office/lab internet, and principal investigator society dues.
categories.review_when: The expense lacks a direct research connection or the annual miscellaneous cap may be exceeded.

categories.examples: Equipment specifically required for the project, including acquisition costs.
categories.review_when: Purpose, approved budget line, or equipment cap is unclear.

categories.examples: Special marine research vessel use under the relevant additional-funding provision.
categories.review_when: There is no explicit marine vessel approval; never infer this category from an ordinary travel or equipment charge.

categories.examples: Overhead in the approved budget summary; generally not an ordinary transaction expense.
categories.review_when: The row is an ordinary cost or the approved overhead basis is not available.

policy_checks: The approved grant budget line controls financial reporting; a category match does not establish eligibility.
The personal-grant guide caps miscellaneous expenses at 15% of each annual budget.
The personal-grant guide caps dedicated equipment at NIS 120,000 including acquisition costs.
Qualifying grant-funded graduate student or postdoctoral scientific travel is limited to NIS 6,000 per year in this guide.

The guide generally excludes applicant or eligible faculty pay, routine travel and per diem, hospitality, foreign visitor costs, building infrastructure, and warehouse loading above 7% of purchase value.
Exceptions require prior written ISF approval.
cross_program_note: Other ISF programs differ: quantum research, MAVRI biomedical research, and publication grants use different headings or limits; do not apply this personal-grant reference to them without their own reference files.
